story.titleZh: TWG否认出售凯迪拉克F1车队
story.summaryZh: TWG否认凯迪拉克F1车队将被出售。此前其CEO马克·沃尔特因涉嫌欺诈和掩盖行为正接受美国司法部和证券交易委员会调查，并已出售其在洛杉矶湖人队的股份。

story.originalTitle: TWG denies sale of Cadillac F1 team
story.summaryEn: TWG has denied that the Cadillac F1 team is up for sale. This follows an investigation into CEO Mark Walter by US authorities over alleged fraud and a cover-up scheme, and his recent sale of his stake in the Los Angeles Lakers.
detailZh: TWG否认凯迪拉克F1车队将被出售，此前其CEO马克·沃尔特在美国接受调查。
马克·沃尔特在F1中可能并不为人熟知，但对凯迪拉克车队而言，他具有根本性的重要性。这位亿万富翁是TWG公司的首席执行官，该公司负责运营通用汽车在F1的参赛项目。目前，他正受到美国当局的审查，这引发了关于车队可能出售的传闻。
近期，沃尔特出售了他在NBA洛杉矶湖人队的股份——仅在他收购一年之后——而美国有报道称，他正在考虑出售他在其他体育项目中的股份，包括英超俱乐部切尔西、美国职棒大联盟的洛杉矶道奇，甚至凯迪拉克F1和Andretti Global。
据报道，这些举措旨在筹集流动性，以应对针对他正在进行的调查。
然而，周四在荷兰大奖赛上，凯迪拉克试图平息猜测，表示车队不会出售。
凯迪拉克F1车队CEO丹·托里斯本周末未出席赞德沃特——这是新领队马尔钦·布德科夫斯基上任后的第一站——因为他正在华盛顿特区与Andretti Autosport一起参加IndyCar赛事，该赛事有美国总统唐纳德·特朗普出席。
马尔钦·布德科夫斯基，凯迪拉克F1车队领队
TWG于2024年从迈克尔·安德雷蒂手中收购了Andretti的股份，这一关键举措使国际汽联、F1和竞争对手车队批准凯迪拉克作为第11支车队参加2026年的比赛。
目前，美国司法部和证券交易委员会正在调查马克·沃尔特，指控其涉嫌欺诈和掩盖行为，涉及他旗下保险公司Delaware Life、Clear Spring和EquiTrust的资金管理。
调查正在审查一个未披露的“自贷”网络的合法性——估计在160至200亿美元之间——这些资金从他的保险公司流向与这位亿万富翁本人有关的企业。
据报道，这些资金通过中介公司和不透明的有限责任公司结构进行流转，以逃避该行业的监管控制和法律限制。
在美国，同一人拥有的公司之间可以合法借贷，前提是交易向监管机构申报，以避免损害对客户的偿付能力。
detailEn: TWG has denied the Cadillac F1 team is up for sale following an investigation into CEO Mark Walter in the US

Mark Walter might be unfamiliar in Formula 1, but for the Cadillac team, he holds fundamental relevance. The billionaire is the CEO of TWG, the company responsible for operating General Motors' Formula 1 entry, and currently he is under scrutiny by authorities in the United States which has sparked rumours regarding a potential sale of the team.

Recently, Walter sold his stake in the NBA's Los Angeles Lakers – just one year after acquiring it – while reports in the US have emerged that he is considering selling his shares in other sports ventures; including Premier League club Chelsea, MLB's Los Angeles Dodgers, and even Cadillac F1 and Andretti Global.
These moves are reportedly aimed at raising liquidity to deal with the ongoing investigation against him.
However, on Thursday at the Dutch Grand Prix, Cadillac sought to quell the speculation by stating the team was not up for sale.

Dan Towriss, Cadillac F1 team CEO, is not in attendance at Zandvoort this weekend – the first round with new team principal Marcin Budkowski at the helm - because he is with Andretti Autosport at the IndyCar race in Washington D.C., an event featuring the presence of U.S. President Donald Trump.
Marcin Budkowski, Team Principal of Cadillac F1 Team
TWG acquired Andretti in 2024 after purchasing the stake from Michael Andretti, a key move that allowed the FIA, F1, and rival teams to approve Cadillac’s entry as the 11th team on the grid for 2026.

Currently, the U.S. Department of Justice and the Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating Mark Walter for an alleged fraud and cover-up scheme involving the management of funds at his insurance companies Delaware Life, Clear Spring, and EquiTrust.

The investigation is examining the legality of a network of undisclosed "self-loans" – estimated between $16-20billion – channelled from his insurance companies to businesses linked to the billionaire himself.
The money reportedly circulated through intermediary firms and an opaque structure of limited liability companies to evade regulatory controls and legal limits in the sector.

In the United States, companies owned by the same individual can legally lend money to one another, provided the transactions are declared to regulators to avoid compromising solvency toward customers.
keyPointsZh: 沃尔特出售湖人股份及可能出售切尔西、洛杉矶道奇、凯迪拉克F1和Andretti Global股份，据称是为应对调查筹集流动性。
凯迪拉克F1车队CEO丹·托里斯未出席赞德沃特荷兰大奖赛，他正在华盛顿特区参加IndyCar赛事，该赛事有美国总统特朗普出席。
美国司法部和证券交易委员会正在调查沃尔特旗下保险公司Delaware Life、Clear Spring和EquiTrust之间约160至200亿美元未披露“自贷”的合法性。
keyPointsEn: Walter's sale of his Lakers stake and possible sales of shares in Chelsea, the Los Angeles Dodgers, Cadillac F1 and Andretti Global are reportedly aimed at raising liquidity to deal with the investigation.
Cadillac F1 team CEO Dan Towriss is not attending the Dutch Grand Prix at Zandvoort as he is at the IndyCar race in Washington D.C., an event attended by U.S. President Donald Trump.

The U.S. Department of Justice and the Securities and Exchange Commission are investigating the legality of undisclosed "self-loans" estimated between $16-20 billion among Walter's insurance companies Delaware Life, Clear Spring and EquiTrust.

relatedItems.summaryZh: F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，26岁的赫塔在从IndyCar转向F2的过程中遇到了比预期更大的困难，但他希望赫塔能够反弹。

relatedItems.originalTitle: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
detailZh: F2总监：赫塔可能低估了F1和IndyCar之间的差距
布鲁诺·米歇尔建议，赫塔在转向F2的过程中遇到了比他预期的更大的困难，但他希望这位美国车手能够反弹。
F2首席执行官布鲁诺·米歇尔表示，赫塔可能低估了F1的二级系列和IndyCar之间的差距，这位26岁的车手的勇敢职业转变至今尚未成功。
赫塔在美国顶级单座赛车系列中一直是领跑者，但决定在2026年回到欧洲——在2015年和2016年参加了跨大西洋的青训车队比赛——以追求他的F1梦想。
在凯迪拉克的F1新车队中获得了测试和开发角色后，赫塔被分配了掌握F2的任务，以便为可能的世界锦标赛晋升做准备。
然而，他在F1的二级系列赛中的首个赛季结果远低于预期。这位加利福尼亚人目前在车手积分榜上排名第19，而且他在整个赛季中的表现水平实际上有所下降——这让他感到困惑——几起事故加剧了他的问题。
“这比我想的要困难得多，因为科尔顿是一个非常强的车手，这一点毫无疑问，”米歇尔评论道。
“他和我们可能低估了我们与IndyCar车队相比的工作环境差异，但我不认为这必须成为一个例子，我真心希望他能够以高水平结束本赛季。我们仍然在为此希望。”
法国人指出，F2复杂的周末赛制，仅有45分钟的自由练习和30分钟的排位赛，可能是赫塔表现不佳的原因之一。
他也有一些不错的比赛，但在排位赛中遇到了更多困难，也许这也是我们遇到的限制之一，因为在30分钟内你需要找到正确的时机[进行你的跑圈]，你只有两次在轮胎上的飞驰圈数，而你在这段有限的时间内几乎没有赛道时间，”米歇尔说。
这也是我们为F1培养车手的方式，因为你知道在F1中你也有有限的赛道时间。
所以，他可能为此而挣扎，并且比他预期的承受了更多的痛苦。现在我真的希望，真诚地希望，他能够以高姿态结束本赛季——他应得的。
赫塔本人对自己的赛季剩余比赛感到不确定，因为卡塔尔和阿布扎比的比赛因伊朗战争而受到威胁，然而米歇尔重申这些赛事“不会取消”。
至于赫塔的未来，Hitech车手明确表示他对第二个F2赛季“没有兴趣”，但他不会排除这种情况，如果凯迪拉克希望他为车队效力。
detailEn: Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” from IndyCar – F2 boss
Bruno Michel suggests Colton Herta struggled “more than what he expected” on his switch to F2 but hopes the American can bounce back
Formula 2 CEO Bruno Michel says Colton Herta “maybe underestimated the difference” between Formula 1’s feeder series and IndyCar, with the 26-year-old’s bold career move so far unsuccessful.

Herta was a frontrunner in America’s premier single-seater series for seven years but decided to move back to Europe in 2026 – having competed in junior formulae across the pond in 2015 and 2016 – in order to chase his F1 dream.
Having landed a test and development role with Cadillac’s nascent F1 team, Herta was tasked with mastering F2 in order to prepare for a potential graduation to the world championship.

However, his maiden season in F1’s feeder series has ended up well below expectations. The Californian lies 19th in the drivers’ standings, and his performance level has actually worsened throughout the year – which he has been at a loss to explain – with several crashes compounding his issues.
“It's been more difficult than what I thought it was going to be, because Colton is a very strong driver, there's no doubt about that,” Michel commented.

“He and we maybe underestimated the difference of working environment that we had compared to IndyCar teams, but I don't think it has to be settled as an example, and I really hope that he's going to finish the season in a high. We're still hoping for that.”
The Frenchman pointed to F2’s tricky weekend format, with just a 45-minute free practice session and a 30-minute qualifying round ahead of the two races, as a potential cause for Herta’s struggle.

“He had some good races as well, he had more difficulties in quali, and maybe also that's one of the limits that we were having, because in 30 minutes you come up with the right timing [for your runs], you have two flying laps on sets of tyres on which you have very limited track time,” Michel said.
“That's also the way we prepare drivers for Formula 1, because you know in Formula 1 that you have limited track time as well.
“So, probably he struggled for that and he suffered from that a bit more than what he expected. Now I really hope, sincerely, that he's going to finish the season on a high – he deserves it.”

Herta himself was unsure he was going to get any more races to finish the season given the Qatar and Abu Dhabi rounds are known to be at threat due to the Iran war, however Michel reaffirmed these events “will not be cancelled”.
As for Herta’s future, the Hitech driver made it clear that he had “no interest” in a sophomore F2 season, but he won’t rule it out in case that’s what Cadillac wants for him.
